name: homie-studio
description: Build games and apps, music and video in this chat, and publish on your own Cloudflare.
long_description: Homie’s engine packages and media skills turn your request into games, apps, sound, music and video. Play from a post on X. Your AI builds and checks it, publishes on your own Cloudflare and connects your own Stripe with one approval. Open source. No terminal or planning interview. For continuous building, choose Always allow for Homie’s tools to keep the build moving.

studios_folder.title: Studios folder
studios_folder.description: Where your studios live: each studio is a folder in it. Homie only reads and writes inside it.
